stem: Fresh pest signs are found while a pruning team is moving through rooms. What should happen?
choices: Apply the supplied stop/isolation and sanitation controls before continuing movement, and escalate the finding
Continue through clean rooms with the same tools
Move suspect plants through clean areas
Prune off evidence and omit the record
rationale: Apply the supplied stop/isolation and sanitation controls before continuing movement, and escalate the finding. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
